title: SPRINGFIELD SYMPHONY: A Holiday Christmas
seo_title: Springfield Symphony: A Holiday Christmas, Dec 19
description: This Springfield Symphony Orchestra concert features music from Christmas movies, including A Charlie Brown Christmas, White Christmas, the Elf soundtrack, and a Frozen medley, and it ends with the Symphony's annual holiday sing-along. It is for all ages. It takes place Saturday, December 19, 2026 at 7:30 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
